t: This is 18 and 19 Kensington Palace Gardens, a building in Kensington and Chelsea. It was designed by Sir Charles Barry, the English architect best known for rebuilding the Palace of Westminster in the mid-nineteenth century. Barry made a major contribution to bringing Italianate architecture to Britain, using the Italian palazzo as a model for country houses, city mansions and public buildings. He also developed the Italian Renaissance garden style for many gardens around country houses.
